Name: MAGIC_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the configuraiton of magic spells.

Fields.Name: Dialog Message ID
Fields.Description: The message shown in the Yes/No dialog when this spell is used.

Fields.Name: Ignore Usage Restriction SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: An effect that lifts this spell's usage limits while active. No vanilla spell uses this.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: The order of this spell in menus.

Fields.Name: Call ID
Fields.Description: The Bullet or SpEffect row this spell fires when cast.

Fields.Name: Mana cost override
Fields.Description: Mana this spell costs per cast while the Mana tweak is on. 0 uses the tweak's derived cost from usages instead. The unmodded game ignores this value.

Fields.Name: Stamina Consumption
Fields.Description: Each cast of this spell spends this much stamina. All spells cost 0 in vanilla DS1.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Which icon shows for this spell in menus.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: The Behavior ID this spell triggers. Unused in the unmodded game.

Fields.Name: Item Requirement for Purchase
Fields.Description: The item the buyer must hold to buy this spell. Unused in the unmodded game.

Fields.Name: State Info Switch: Magic ID
Fields.Description: The spell this becomes when State Info Switch: Value matches. -1 turns the swap off. Unused in the unmodded game.

Fields.Name: Usage Count
Fields.Description: Casts allowed before a bonfire rest restores them. -1 means unlimited. The Mana tweak derives this spell's default mana cost from it.

Fields.Name: Humanity Consumption
Fields.Description: Humanity spent each time this spell is cast. Casting fails without enough.

Fields.Name: Maximum Dexterity
Fields.Description: Unknown. Its effect is not documented.

Fields.Name: Particle Variation ID
Fields.Description: Shifts which particle effect the cast animation plays.

Fields.Name: Slot Usage
Fields.Description: How many attunement slots this spell takes.

Fields.Name: Requirement: INT
Fields.Description: The lowest Intelligence that can cast this spell.

Fields.Name: Requirement: FTH
Fields.Description: The lowest Faith that can cast this spell.

Fields.Name: Casting Speed Range: Start
Fields.Description: Dexterity where faster casting starts. Below this, Dexterity does not change cast speed. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Casting Speed Range: End
Fields.Description: Dexterity where faster casting stops improving. Above this, more Dexterity does not shorten the cast. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Magic School Type
Fields.Description: The school of this spell. It decides which tool can cast it.

Fields.Name: Call ID Type
Fields.Description: Whether the Call ID is a Bullet or a SpEffect.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Which power-boosting effects can raise this spell. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Motion Category
Fields.Description: Which casting animation set this spell uses.

Fields.Name: Menu Type on Usage
Fields.Description: The type of menu to display when the spell is used.

Fields.Name: State Info Switch: Value
Fields.Description: The State Info value that swaps this spell for another. Unused in the unmodded game.

Fields.Name: State Info Switch: Replacement Category
Fields.Description: Which bonus shifts this spell to a stronger row. Higher resonance or covenant rank fires a later row. The exact mapping is not established.

Fields.Name: Usage Limit: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Effects that block this spell while active. Casting fails while a clashing effect runs.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: None
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works with no covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Way of White
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Way of White covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Princess Guard
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Princess Guard covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Warrior of Sunlight
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Warrior of Sunlight covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Darkwraith
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Darkwraith covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Path of the Dragon
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Path of the Dragon covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Gravelord Servant
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Gravelord Servant covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Forest Hunter
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Forest Hunter covenant.

Fields.Name: Usable in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Usable in Multiplayer Only
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell only works in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Is Weapon Enchantment
Fields.Description: If ON, the game treats this as a weapon enchant. What difference that makes is not established.

Fields.Name: Is Shield Enchantment
Fields.Description: If ON, the game treats this as a shield enchant. What difference that makes is not established.

Fields.Name: Enable in Multiplayer: Host
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in human form. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Enable in Multiplayer: Gray Phantom
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works while hollow. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Enable in Multiplayer: White Phantom
Fields.Description: If ON, white phantoms can cast this. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Enable in Multiplayer: Black Phantom
Fields.Description: If ON, black phantoms can cast this. The exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Disable when Offline
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell only works online.

Fields.Name: Trigger Resonance
Fields.Description: If ON, casting this sends white rings to other players. Standing near rings boosts matching spells.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Blade of the Dark Moon
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Blade of the Dark Moon covenant.

Fields.Name: Vow Type: Chaos Servant
Fields.Description: If ON, this spell works in the Chaos Servant covenant.
